ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels concentrated on distal lobes versus 55% low-intensity dark charcoal/black pixels concentrated in the central and peduncle regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity regions occupy the outer thirds of both lobes. Central zone is a solid dark low-intensity mass. High-contrast dark linear streaks and splatter patterns are mapped over the distal white regions, with higher density on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire visible boundary. Right distal tip shows high-amplitude (5-10 pixel depth) jagged peaks; left distal tip shows lower-frequency, shallower peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips, resulting in an 'S-curve' profile as the trailing edge meets the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity circular and sub-circular clusters (2-5 pixels in diameter) visible against the dark central background, primarily in the lower-central region near the water line.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-on-white linear rake marks present on both lobes; left lobe features approximately 5-7 parallel diagonal tracks; right lobe features a dense, chaotic network of intersecting linear marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear disruptions) across the distal regions of both lobes, suggesting previous contact/interaction marks that break the base white pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Right distal lobe exhibits a unique high-density 'salt and pepper' pigmentation pattern near the trailing edge that differs significantly from the more linear marking on the left lobe.
